description.content: Create, read, update, and delete monitors

Creates a new monitor with the specified configuration. The monitor type determines which query language and threshold options are available. Monitors can alert on metric thresholds, anomalies, log patterns, APM traces, synthetic test results, and more. Upon creation, Datadog begins evaluating the monitor against the defined query and will send notifications when alert conditions are met.
